channel.title: Magnus Ferreira: All the Latest Rock and Metal News on Loud Legends
channel.description: Recent content in Magnus Ferreira: All the Latest Rock and Metal News on Loud Legends

item.title: Michael Paget Says BULLET FOR MY VALENTINE's New Album Will Feature 'Crazy Tuning'
item.description: Guitarist Michael “Padge” Paget says BULLET FOR MY VALENTINE is exploring new territory on their next studio album, including tunings the band has never used before. The longtime member of the Welsh metalcore group opened up about the upcoming record during a chat at this year’s Download Festival in the UK (watch the interview below).

item.title: The Backstage Incident That Made KERRY KING Call a Rock Icon a 'Complete Jerk'
item.description: Not everyone in the world of music gets along, and that includes some of its biggest stars. Even in heavy metal, a genre known for its intensity and larger-than-life personalities, there are musicians who just don’t click.

item.title: Dave 'PHOENIX' Farrell Breaks Silence on CHESTER BENNINGTON’s Death: 'Is It Even Called LINKIN PARK Anymore?'
item.description: Linkin Park bassist Dave “Phoenix” Farrell opened up about the band’s long road back to music after the loss of lead singer Chester Bennington. In a new interview with Czech station Evropa 2 (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH.

item.title: BULLET FOR MY VALENTINE's Michael Paget On New Album: 'It's Gonna Be Super Heavy'
item.description: BULLET FOR MY VALENTINE is working on new music, and according to guitarist Michael “Padge” Paget, fans should expect something heavier than ever before. The Welsh metal band recently cut its joint tour with Trivium short, choosing to focus instead on writing and recording their next studio album.

item.title: MEGADETH's DAVE MUSTAINE On the 'Puppy Incident': 'JAMES Got Punched In The Mouth. He Kicked My Dog'
item.description: There’s no elegant way to introduce a story that ends with James Hetfield catching a mouthful of knuckles. Especially when the instigating factor was a puppy. But here we are.

item.title: Ex-EXODUS RICK HUNOLT Looks Back On Thrash Origins: 'We Inspired METALLICA And SLAYER'
item.description: Ex-EXODUS guitarist Rick Hunolt didn’t bother dancing around it during a recent chat with Pod Scum host Rexx Ruger (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH.NET). When Ruger put Hunolt and Gary Holt on the same tier as Hetfield/Hammett or Hanneman/King, Hunolt didn’t blink.

item.title: LINKIN PARK Cancels Switzerland Concert After Health Problem in Band: 'We’re Not In A Spot To Perform Tonight'
item.description: Linkin Park called off their performance in Bern, Switzerland just hours before showtime, citing a medical issue within the band. The June 20 concert at Bernexpo was part of the group’s 2025 world tour promoting From Zero, their first album since 2017.

item.title: The GRUNGE Band JAMES HETFIELD Says 'Saved Music': 'It was exactly what music needed'
item.description: Back when rock was drowning in mousse and tight pants, Nirvana kicked down the door like a grunge-splattered SWAT team. Metallica? They’d already been tearing limbs off with thrash riffs from the Bay Area for a decade.

item.title: STEVE DIGIORGIO On Recording With DAVE MUSTAINE: 'He Wasn't What I Expected'
item.description: Steve DiGiorgio, longtime bassist for Testament, has spoken candidly about his brief but intense experience recording with Dave Mustaine for Megadeth’s album The Sick, The Dying… And The Dead!

item.title: When METALLICA Brought Back 'FRANTIC' Live And JAMES HETFIELD Roasted St. Anger
item.description: Back in 2021, Metallica briefly resurrected “Frantic”, the chaotic opener from their 2003 punching bag of an album, St. Anger. The band pulled the song out of retirement for a set at the Aftershock Festival on October 8 (watch the video below), years after it had mostly vanished from live shows following a few scattered appearances in 2019 and a much longer break since 2011.

item.title: CHURCH Tries to Shut Down MARILYN MANSON in Mexico: 'Mocks Faith, Promotes Evil'
item.description: Marilyn Manson is scheduled to perform at the FENAPO, the National Fair of San Luis Potosí, on August 10 at the Teatro del Pueblo, with free admission. However, the Catholic Church tried to shut it down.

item.title: AVENGED SEVENFOLD's M. SHADOWS On Being Misunderstood: 'People Are Just Getting It Now'
item.description: M. Shadows isn’t mad. He’s just… already moved on. If Life Is But a Dream… finally makes sense to you in 2025, congrats on solving the puzzle.

item.title: JESSE LEACH Talks About KILLSWITCH ENGAGE's 'Aftermath': 'We All Have a Responsibility'
item.description: Killswitch Engage isn’t wasting time with metaphors or feel-good slogans in their latest single. The video for “Aftermath” just dropped, and it doesn’t sugarcoat a thing. If you were expecting a fun, breakdown-heavy anthem about “staying strong,” keep scrolling.

item.title: BLACK SABBATH's Tony Iommi Talks About Final Show Concerns: 'The Unknown Worries Me'
item.description: Tony Iommi, the ever-present architect of Black Sabbath, isn’t exactly sleeping easy as the band’s farewell inches closer. Set for July 5 in Birmingham, England, the hometown gig isn’t just another concert.

item.title: AC/DC Reportedly Planning Final Concerts For Late 2025 In Australia
item.description: According to behind-the-scenes information obtained by Blunt magazine, AC/DC is expected to announce what could be the final concerts of their career, scheduled for late 2025 (Get AC/DC Tickets Here).

item.title: Mike Portnoy Surprises Son Max With Dream Theater Drum Challenge at Drumeo
item.description: Max Portnoy walked into Drumeo expecting a normal day. Instead, his father, Mike Portnoy, waited for him with a surprise. Mike asked his son to play Honor Thy Father by Dream Theater without any practice.

item.title: Steel Panther Expands 2025 "Feel The Steel" Tour With New U.S. And Europe Dates
item.description: Fifteen years after dropping their debut Feel The Steel, Steel Panther is still out there doing what they do best: mocking, exaggerating, and somehow keeping hair metal alive with a straight face and a wink.

item.title: David Ellefson Breaks Down Megadeth’s Risk and Its Divisive Legacy
item.description: In 1999, Megadeth rolled the dice with Risk, a record that veered sharply away from the band’s thrash metal identity. For David Ellefson, the album remains, in his own words, “probably the most controversial album in the catalog.

item.title: Disturbed & Megadeth Join Forces for The Sickness 25th-Anniversary Tour
item.description: Okay—stop what you’re doing—pause Love Island, put down the ghost pepper challenge, mute your ex’s chaotic MySpace playlist from 2008 (yes, it still plays in your head)—because we need to talk about DISTURBED and MEGADETH teaming up for a European tour in 2025… and frankly, the timeline has collapsed in on itself.

item.title: KILLSWITCH ENGAGE Shares Music Video For 'Collusion' Single From 'This Consequence' Album
item.description: Killswitch Engage is back with This Consequence, their ninth studio album, and they’ve just unleashed a music video for the track “Collusion”, which, spoiler alert, is NOT about happy things.

item.title: Zakk Wylde’s Black Label Society Drops 'Lord Humungus'—New Single Out Now
item.description: you ever hear a song so ridiculously heavy it makes you wanna run through a wall—like, FULL Kool-Aid Man mode—except the wall is made of steel and your doctor is already tired of your bullshit?

item.title: Heidi Shepherd Speaks Out on Vocal Training: “I Was a Singer Before I Was a Screamer”
item.description: Apparently some people still think Heidi Shepherd—frontwoman of BUTCHER BABIES, growler of unholy things, destroyer of vocal cords (except, not hers, more on that later)—can’t sing. And she’s had enough.

item.title: Max Cavalera on Re-Recording SEPULTURA’s Early Albums: “They Never Sounded Right”
item.description: Oh boy, here we go. Another “let’s redo our old stuff, but this time better” kind of deal. You know, like when you rewrite a high school essay as an adult and suddenly realize, wow, I really didn’t understand metaphors back then.

item.title: VOIVOD’s Sci-Fi Movie Ambition Lives On as They Collaborate with a Symphony
item.description: VOIVOD still wants to do a sci-fi movie, a long-time goal for the band. In a recent interview with Bilal Butt on CHOM 97.7, guitarist Daniel “Chewy” Mongrain said it’s still a creative goal.

item.title: NONPOINT Drummer Hospitalized After Onstage Health Scare
item.description: Sunday night at the Mercury Ballroom? Ended on a tense note. Why? Drummer Robb Rivera’s heart decided to test its own limits—dangerously high beats-per-minute (like it was auditioning for a drum solo).

item.title: Cradle Of Filth: Ashok Šmerda and Zoë Marie Federoff marry in a gothic ceremony
item.description: Two Cradle Of Filth bandmates just got hitched. (Yes, you read that right. And it’s almost too metal to handle.) Guitarist Marek “Ashok” Šmerda and keyboardist Zoë Marie Federoff promised forever this week, and Dani Filth celebrated by posting a barrage of wedding photos for the goths, the headbangers, and everyone in between.

item.title: Ryan McCombs Wishes Social Media Never Existed—But He Still Uses It
item.description: Ryan McCombs—frontman of Drowning Pool and SOIL, master of growls, occasional philosopher—has thoughts about social media. Big ones. Messy ones. The kind that make you nod along until he throws in a time-travel fantasy about stopping Zuckerberg in his tracks (we’ll get there).

item.title: Slipknot’s Clown Talks Delays for 'Look Outside Your Window'
item.description: Back in 2024, Shawn “Clown” Crahan of Slipknot confidently announced that the long-teased *Look Outside Your Window* would finally see the light of day this year. Fast forward to November, and here we are: still no album.

item.title: Tim Lambesis to Continue As I Lay Dying After Major Band Departures
item.description: Tim Lambesis seems hell-bent on keeping As I Lay Dying alive, despite the complete meltdown the band’s endured recently. Over the past few weeks, total chaos erupted as band members exited left and right without a word from Lambesis, until now.

item.title: Slipknot's New 'S' Logo Sparks Outrage Among Fans
item.description: Slipknot has rolled out a batch of limited edition merchandise, and one particular shirt seems to have set off quite the tempest. On the front? The band’s name—classic enough.

item.title: Former Ozzy Osbourne Guitarist Jake E. Lee Shot in Random Attack
item.description: Guitarist Jake E. Lee, known for shredding alongside Ozzy Osbourne and his own projects like Badlands and Red Dragon Cartel, took quite an unexpected hit this week—literally. Early Tuesday, Lee was shot multiple times while out for an early morning stroll in Las Vegas.

item.title: Sick New World 2025 Lineup Announced: Metallica, Linkin Park & More
item.description: Sick New World 2025 is coming in hard, and this lineup is anything but subtle. Let’s cut to the chase—Metallica and Linkin Park are headlining. What? Metallica showing up at a festival that usually leans nü-metal?

item.title: The Surprise You Missed in Korn’s 1997 Track "A.D.I.D.A.S."
item.description: Ever really listened to the breakdown in Korn’s 1997 track “A.D.I.D.A.S.”? And I mean actually listened—ears glued to every sound, every tiny layer. There’s a surprise in there you probably missed.

item.title: As I Lay Dying Previews 'Through Storms Ahead' With New Single; VIDEO
item.description: As I Lay Dying has rolled out their latest offering, “Whitewashed Tomb,” a mid-tempo track that gives a preview of their upcoming album, Through Storms Ahead, slated for release on November 15.

item.title: CLOWN Reflects on SLIPKNOT's Evolution: "We’re Not as Close as We Once Were"
item.description: Slipknot has certainly had its fair share of shake-ups since their 1999 self-titled debut. Founding bassist Paul Gray passed away in 2010. Founding drummer Joey Jordison followed in 2021.

item.title: Watch: Mushroomhead Fans Clash with Slipknot in 1999 Show
item.description: Back in 1999, the tension between Slipknot and Mushroomhead wasn’t just gossip, it was a full-on warzone. A recently resurfaced video from a Cleveland Slipknot show captures this beautiful disaster in all its chaotic glory.

item.title: AS I LAY DYING and Jordan Mancino Part Ways: Legal Drama and New Drummer Nick Pierce
item.description: Jordan Mancino, the drummer who had been with As I Lay Dying since the early days, seems to have permanently checked out. Not in a quiet, amicable way either—this one comes with lawyers, statements, and all the usual mess you’d expect when band relationships implode.

item.title: Did Slipknot’s Website Just Confirm Their New Drummer?
item.description: Slipknot’s grand reveal of their mystery drummer is just days away, set to coincide with their live performance at Sick New World. But a few determined internet detectives might have already beaten the band to the punch.

item.title: Korn’s Creative Process: Ray Luzier Breaks Down the Band’s Approach
item.description: Korn’s drummer, Ray Luzier, has been pounding the skins for the band since 2007, and he’s got plenty of stories to tell. In a chat with Modern Drummer, Luzier reflected on some of the band’s most memorable moments, from their biggest hits to their more out-there experiments.

item.title: Metallica Wins Best Metal Performance, Only Trujillo Attends GRAMMYs
item.description: Metallica snags the Best Metal Performance GRAMMY, but if you think the band showed up in full force to accept it, think again. As usual, the GRAMMYs treated metal like an afterthought, burying the award for “72 Seasons” in the untelevised dungeon.

item.title: MTV Names Metallica in Best Rock Category for EMA 2023
item.description: Metallica Earns a Nod for an MTV European Music Award—But Don’t Get Too Excited. Since the infamous moment when Jethro Tull snagged a Grammy over Metallica, metalheads everywhere learned that mainstream award shows are, for the most part, a waste of time.

item.title: Metallica’s Classic Albums Return in Limited Colored Vinyl Reissues
item.description: Metallica’s bringing out the big guns with their upcoming reissue series, serving up their classic albums on colored vinyl as if you haven’t bought these a few times already.

item.title: Watch: Metallica Pays Tribute to Megaforce Founders with Old-School Set
item.description: Metallica recently gave fans a nostalgic kick in the gut with a special throwback show that would make any old-school fan tear up—if they’re still capable of crying, that is.
